name: template-creator
description: Create and update personal templates from files, ImageGen or Product Design images, emails, and Slack messages.

interface.shortDescription: Create or update reusable templates from reference content
interface.longDescription: Use Template Creator to create reusable templates from documents, spreadsheets, presentations, ImageGen or Product Design images, emails, and Slack messages. Template Creator preserves the structure, voice, layout, and style of your reference so you can quickly create new versions whenever you need them.
